card.name: The word to after compared
card.fires_on: The word "to" right after "compared" (or "as compared") when a drug-treated group's rate is set against placebo or another treatment. It also fires weakly on "following" after a noun.

modes.label: compared to
modes.description: "to" after "compared" in adverse-event rate comparisons between treatment groups.
modes.example: experienced lower respiratory tract infections compared<< to>> 9% of patients on placebo.

modes.label: as compared to
modes.description: "to" after "as compared" when comparing risk against another therapy.
modes.example: associated with increased cardiovascular mortality as compared<< to>> treatment with diet alone or diet plus insulin

modes.label: following
modes.description: The word "following" after a noun, as in after a vaccination.

card.plain: It marks the word "to" in "compared to" where a drug group's side-effect rate is weighed against placebo or another drug.
